description: Built-in (calm): approve, reject or defer up to 12 items, one at a time (choice labels can be the payload's own). The current item is a card (source and kind, due date, detail, copy icons, a segmented choice and an optional note); the others are quiet rows (the request, then source and kind). What the agent already handled sits under one closed disclosure. Result: one choice and note per item plus an overall note.
